detailed_descriptions.en: Play as modern cartoon renditions of classic characters Lancelot, Mother Goose, even the Piglet TOY that inspired Winnie-The-Pooh! Gorgeous hand-drawn artwork brings every stage, every character, every moment of battle to life! Even the music is remixed from the ground-up from the public domain! Like our "Punk-Rockabye Baby" Gorgeous optional visual effects like FILM GRAIN and CEL SHADOW provide a fuzzy nostalgic feeling! LIGHT, STRONG, and SPECIAL attacks make the zany flow of combat feel straightforward without directional input, so first-time players can join the party! Genre veterans will find depth and complexity preserved in familiar mechanics like moonwalking, foxtrotting, and more: even WAVEDASHING has an easy introduction for new players with an optional single-button command! CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS let anyone play with exactly the button layout you're looking for! Genre veterans can even choose from our pre-set profiles inspired by the layouts of other platform fighting greats, in order to feel right at home. Enjoy our pre-made rulesets, or customize your own! PARTY MODE warps out-of-bounds players across the screen instead of eliminations—no more disheartening SDs! The LEGAL rules run tournament-legal settings and bans casual stages from random selection STOCK , TIME , STAMINA , TEAMS , even ITEM and RANDOM STAGE toggles are here! Hone your skills and take them online with our rollback netcode, or stay home and have a party fit for Gatsby! ONLINE QUICKPLAY for fast 1v1 matches PRIVATE LOBBIES to group with up to four friends plus spectators! ROLLBACK NETCODE makes for a smooth online experience! (Ethernet is always recommended) Enjoy their exciting combos and hilarious interactions together in local multiplayer—or online with rollback netcode

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
• Play as modern cartoon renditions of classic characters Lancelot, Mother Goose, even the Piglet TOY that inspired Winnie-The-Pooh!

  • Gorgeous hand-drawn artwork brings every stage, every character, every moment of battle to life!

  • Even the music is remixed from the ground-up from the public domain! Like our "Punk-Rockabye Baby"

  • Gorgeous optional visual effects like FILM GRAIN and CEL SHADOW provide a fuzzy nostalgic feeling!

  • LIGHT, STRONG, and SPECIAL attacks make the zany flow of combat feel straightforward without directional input, so first-time players can join the party!

  • Genre veterans will find depth and complexity preserved in familiar mechanics like moonwalking, foxtrotting, and more: even WAVEDASHING has an easy introduction for new players with an optional single-button command!

  • CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS let anyone play with exactly the button layout you're looking for! Genre veterans can even choose from our pre-set profiles inspired by the layouts of other platform fighting greats, in order to feel right at home.

Enjoy our pre-made rulesets, or customize your own!

  • PARTY MODE warps out-of-bounds players across the screen instead of eliminations—no more disheartening SDs!

  • The LEGAL rules run tournament-legal settings and bans casual stages from random selection

  • STOCK, TIME, STAMINA, TEAMS, even ITEM and RANDOM STAGE toggles are here!

Hone your skills and take them online with our rollback netcode, or stay home and have a party fit for Gatsby!

  • ONLINE QUICKPLAY for fast 1v1 matches

  • PRIVATE LOBBIES to group with up to four friends plus spectators!

  • ROLLBACK NETCODE makes for a smooth online experience! (Ethernet is always recommended)

Enjoy their exciting combos and hilarious interactions together in local multiplayer—or online with rollback netcode
